item.title: Psalm 125, Standing Firm Because the Lord Surrounds His People
item.description: In this episode of Walking Through the Psalms, Dave Jenkins teaches Psalm 125 and explains how God’s people stand firm because the Lord surrounds them with covenant care.

item.title: Sanctification, How God Shapes Our Daily Life in Christ
item.description: In this Contending for the Word Q&A episode, Dave Jenkins explains what sanctification is and how it shapes daily Christian living through God’s Word and the power of the Holy Spirit.

item.title: Yoga and Spiritual Warfare, Why the Roots Matter for Christians
item.description: Yoga is not spiritually neutral. This episode explains yoga’s spiritual roots, its connection to spiritual warfare, and why Christians must practice biblical discernment.

item.title: Job 7: Life Is a Breath, God Is Merciful
item.description: In Job 7, Job speaks honestly to God in the weariness of suffering, reminding us that life is brief, God is merciful, and He invites our honest prayers.

item.title: How Christians Fight Sin Biblically, Hope for the Battle Against Temptation
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how Christians fight sin biblically through their identity in Christ, reliance on the Holy Spirit, the daily use of the means of grace, and fixing their eyes on Jesus. Drawing from Romans 6 and 8, Colossians 3, Ephesians 4, and Galatians 5, this episode offers biblical hope for the ongoing battle against temptation.

item.title: Job 8: When Simplistic Theology Wounds the Suffering
item.description: Job 8 reveals how Bildad’s counsel lacks compassion. This Bible study explains why simplistic theology fails and how Christ reshapes true comfort.

item.title: True Revival vs. False Revival: Biblical Discernment from Scripture
item.description: In this episode of Weekly Watch, Dave Jenkins explains how Scripture distinguishes true revival from false revival and equips Christians with biblical discernment rooted in God’s Word.
